I re-derived the schedule from the constraints and got the same answer.

Elif, Finn, Ben and Gus occupy consecutive slots E, F, B, G, starting at slot f. Cara must be at f+3, since f−1 is Elif's slot. Ivo must be at f−2, since f+2 is Gus's slot. Dev is after Gus, Cara and Finn, and Ann is after Dev, so Ann is at most slot 8 and Hana (Ann+1) at most slot 9. That forces f = 3, which puts Dev at 7, Ann at 8 and Hana at 9.

Every clause checks against this schedule. The team note is also correct: Cara must sit exactly two slots after Ben.
